title: The Pulse: tech companies move to open AI models
author: Ivan Klaric
description: Uber, Pinterest, Stripe, Coinbase, Ramp, and AT&T are making large savings on their AI bills by dropping proprietary models and using smart model routing.
summary: Update: three weeks after publishing this article, Bloomberg covered the same trend in their article OpenAI, Anthropic costs push more startups to build off cheaper open models , covering the exact same phenomenon we discuss below.
